_comment: Copy to local.config.json (gitignored) and edit. Absent or empty is fine — the managed-doc render and project-hook validation simply no-op. Set push to false on machines that must never push (e.g. a corporate laptop); commits stay local.
_windows_corporate_note: On a locked-down Windows machine: set link_mode to 'copy' (symlinks denied by group policy) and push to false. Run ai-sync from Git Bash. python3 and python are both tried automatically by hook scripts.
_scrub_patterns_note: Regexes for employer/product/client names the push gate must never let into the published tree. Case-insensitive. Write every separator a name can take — 'big[ ._-]?client' catches bigclient, big-client and big client. These live here, not in bin/tests/test_repo_shape.py, because that file is published: literals there would leak the very names they exist to remove, and it excludes itself from its own scan so it would never notice. Absent means the identifier half of the scrub reports SKIP; the generic /Users/ path check always runs.
